notes.title: Leaving Early Access today!
notes.notes:
Lost Empire 2977 has been in development for many years and is finally ready to leave Early Access!

[h3]Is the game complete?[/h3]
Yes, the core game is complete, and we have added many side-missions and areas to explore, along with the main story/quest line to give the feeling of a living sci-fi universe.

[h3]Will the game be supported in the future?[/h3]
Of course! As any game we publish, the plan is to support the game for a long time, adding new content and improvements.

[h3]Can I see gameplay videos and play-throughs?[/h3]
 You can see extended gameplay videos on our YouTube channel:
https://www.youtube.com/playlist?list=PLSOfWRaYhknX--42qAr5d-EIa7aYiDNYB

[h3]Will there be more content?[/h3]
We hope so! If the game gains enough traction and player feedback is positive, there will be more content. We hope to explore the backstory of both team-members, the two other ARK stations, add more bounty-hunter missions and perhaps introduce one or two more fractions (with separate side-quests). We also have plans for a sequel.

What happens next is up to the players - there is basically no limit to how big this universe can become. If people like the game and give positive feedback, the game will grow and gain new content.

[h3]Are all the bugs fixed?[/h3]
We have only one bug that has been reported lately, that will be patched within a short time (audio volume resets to 0 when exiting a level while combat music is playing or force-stopping the game).

If anyone experience bugs, please report them in the forums and we'll start working on a fix asap.

notes.title: Full release version 1.0.0 is now live!
notes.notes:

[h3]IMPORTANT NOTE: INVENTORY SYSTEM HAS BEEN FULLY OVERHAULED AND ALL PLAYERS ARE RECOMMENDED TO START A NEW CHARACTER/GAME. CONTINUING ON A PREVIOUS SAVE WILL CAUSE ISSUES![/h3]

[h3]The list of the most important improvements:[/h3]
[list]
[*] Orion Station is upgraded with more NPC's, ships and activities
[*] Orion Hotel has opened
[*] Added camera adjustments: Armed/unarmed can be set separately
[*] Physics improvements
[*] Updated character creation screen
[*] UI updated
[*] Warp effect on spaceship in "sub-space FTT" (afterburner)
[*] Player ship now has unlimited afterburner
[*] Improved ship handling
[*] Vehicle physics and handling improved
[*] Jetpack transitions and movement improved
[*] Flight (jetpack) characteristics/handling improved (PhysX behaviour)
[*] Added "lore records" that can be unlocked throughout the game
[*] New start menu
[*] New game menu
[*] Save/Load has been fully overhauled and should work without issues
[*] Camera "jittering" is fixed
[*] More items, clothing and improved outfits
[*] Improved player character textures
[*] Player armor plates upgrade option added (strengthens your armor)
[*] Crafting is now fully developed and allows to craft many useful items and upgrades
[*] Credit-check issue fixed
[*] ARK station level 1: New construction and improved performance + more loot
[*] Unknown planet level 1 and 2: Improved performance and more loot
[*] "The Dunes" level 1 and 2: Added enemies, improved performance, and bug-fixes
[*] Riva Prime, level 1 and 2: Improved performance, added details and bug-fixes
[*] The Death guilds base: Improved visual, added details and bug fixes (mission)
[*] Ship upgrade window updated/improved
[*] More items added

[*] More voices/dialogues

[h3]Known issues[/h3]

[/list]

If anyone experience bugs, please (as always) report them in the Steam forum and we will start working on a fix asap.

Thanks to everyone who has helped by reporting bugs and issues, and as the last update, especially Wise primate and Romulus! Your help has been truly invaluable!

For now: Merry Christmas and a lovely holiday!

notes.title: Update 4 patch
notes.notes:
Update 4 has implemented many new features, including a new save/load function with multiple saves. This also included a new save folder in "my documents" instead of the old folder. The new save location has caused issues for some players as the game was unable to find or access the folder.

To fix this issue the save location is reverted to the old folder, also meaning that old save-games will be working again.

There are also a few issues with the controller and other features that will be fixed shortly.

Update 4 was an extensive update and bugs / issues have been expected. 

The last few days before full release is focused mainly to address all the bugs/issues and if you experience problems, don't hesitate to report them!

notes.title: Update 4 is now live! The final update before full release.
notes.notes:
[h1]Major updates[/h1]
[list]
[*] Translation to German, French, Spanish and Italian.
[*] Controller support (X-box / PS-4 controllers) with aim-assist and controller key-mapping options. The game now fulfil all requirements for the Steam "full controller support" label.
[*] Multiple save options: 3 save slots + auto-save and quick-save for every character (unlimited character saves).
[*] Melee weapons and shields (sword+shield). New inventory slot for swords.
[*] Mo-cap animations for both player-characters main movement (unarmed/armed).
[*] Major improvement to the male main character.
[*] Cover features is greatly improved with aim/shoot from behind cover options.
[*] Improved jet-pack transitions, animations, and particles.
[*] A complete side-quest "headhunter" thread with 4 missions and player rewards.
[*] Possibility for attaining a player apartment on Orion station (reward for mission)
[*] New level/scene structure to improve load times and conform with "best practice".
[*] 179+ bug/issue fixes.
[*] Improved(increased) camera limits and default settings.
[*] Performance improvements and optimizations.
[/list]
[h3]Important update notes:[/h3]
[list]
[*] The default save folder is now moved to "...*Documents\My Games\Lost Empire 2977".
[*] The new melee equipment-slot might disrupt previous saves
[*] The old save-folder and save-files can manually be moved to the new folder (must be complete with all files). This is not recommended and might result in unwanted bugs and issues. The reason for this is the changed inventory window structure/melee slots, not the new save system.
[*] The new save system need testing and if anyone experience bugs and issues, please report this in the forum. All internal testing indicate it is stable and working, but all test machines have the same default file configuration (windows 10).
[/list]
[h3]Is the game complete?[/h3]
Yes, but there are more bug-fixing and some final updates/additions left. Anyone experiencing bugs are urged to report this in the Steam forums, so they can be fixed before full release. 

If players want additional features and content, now is the time to add requests in the forums!
[h3]When will the full release be published?[/h3]
In just a week or two. All bugs must be checked off the fix-list and a few additions are planned.

notes.title: Game version 1.0 is released
notes.notes:
[h3]WHAT UPDATES AND IMPROVEMENTS HAVE BEEN MADE IN VERSION 1.0?[/h3]

There are many updates and impossible to mention all of them. 

The most important improvements have been made to the character controller, RPG elements and the space combat/exploration element. The gameplay have also been streamlined and polished. Many of these elements have been rewritten/remade and should give players a much better experience.

[b]A LIST OF THE MOST IMPORTANT UPDATES:[/b]
[list]
[*] Player controller completely remade
[*] Updated and improved animations
[*] Updated and remade the Companion framework
[*] Improved UI
[*] Added a Jetpack and jetpack upgrades
[*] Improved character creation and development
[*] Introduced new RPG elements and stats
[*] Improved crafting and upgrades
[*] Added upgrades to the spaceship
[*] Improved space combat and exploration
[*] Updated the vehicle
[*] Streamlined the gameplay, making it a pure 3rd person that better suit the game and storyline. Also removed some elements that players didn’t enjoy or understand.
[*] Many areas have been completely remade from ground up, to better suit the gameplay and more detail and content have been added.
[*] Voices added to all dialogues
[/list]

The following weeks, we will be uploading gameplay videos and more trailers to Steam, and also to our YouTube channel.

[h3]WHAT REMAINS BEFORE A FULL LAUNCH?[/h3]
A few things must be completed and polished before the game is ready for the full release:

[list]
[*] More side-quests: Exploring planets, exploring derelict spaceships / stations, mercenary missions etc..
[*] Bug fixing 
[*] More comprehensive testing
[*] Steam achievements and stats
[*] Translations to other languages
[*] Optimizing and polishing
[*] Improving enemies that not yet have been updated/improved
[/list]

The last few weeks before full launch will be intense in terms of development and testing. Players who have thoughts and opinions about the gameplay, are invited to join the forums and share their opinions!

notes.title: WEEK LONG sale almost over!
notes.notes:
In less than 20 hours, the week long sale will be over. If you are interested in the game and want to support the development, this is the perfect time to grab it!

With update 4.0 the whole main story-line is done and the game can be played from beginning to end. 



[h3]Will it be completed?[/h3]

Yes! With almost two years of development, it's only a few months of work left. Most of the core mechanics are done and most of the areas are done.

What's left is:
[list]
[*] RPG elements: Follower quests and side-quests
[*] More dialogues
[*] More and improved voice-overs 
[*] More areas (5 new areas are almost complete)
[*] Polish
[*] Improving the save/load functionality 
[/list]

To sum up, we are not worried about completing the game but hope to get one or two weeks of extra development time on the project.

notes.title: Update 4.0 - A complete game!
notes.notes:
[h2]Update 4: game version 0.95[/h2]
There is still work left before the game is finished and moved from Early Access, but now the whole main story is revealed and you can play the game from start to finish.

Find out what the Guardians where and why they no longer exist. Explore alien planets and star systems. Fight enemies in space and on the ground. Gather the full team of followers

[h3]The major updates are:[/h3]
[list]
[*] 5 new areas to visit
[*] More LOOT: 50 new lootable items
[*] More LOOT 2: 10 new legendary items 
[*] New followers
[*] Bigger team size (total of 5 followers and you)
[*] Improved UI
[*] Improved visuals
[*] Improved 3rd person camera movement
[*] Improved top-down camera scripts
[*] Improved space combat
[*] 5 new enemy units, including a Sanmari space fighter
[*] Improved power/magic UI interface and mechanics (still some work left though)
[*] Spacecraft now has afterburner
[*] More vendors to buy/sell equipment
[*] New enemy factions
[*] More dialogues with team members
[*] Improved follower logic
[*] Improved enemy logic
[*] Upgrades to your spacecraft
[*] Improved save functionality, most areas now save player progress automatically (currently no save in space - this is next on the list)
[/list]

[h3]Known issues:[/h3]
[list]
[*] Combat armor (female) get stuck in "T-pose" after loading game (temporary fix: change armor to another and change back)
[*] UI get corrupted (temporary fix: don't use FRAPS or restart game) (memory issue)
[*] Radeon cards: Game freeze after multitasking in windows (temporary fix: disable Enhanced sync)
[*] Level 4 (first planet scene), camera movement stutters 
[*] Afterburner doesn't shut down
[/list]

Fixes for these issues should be ready within a few days.

[h3]What is left to do before final launch?[/h3]

The game is getting close to the final version, but there are still many things that must be completed and improved:
[list]
[*] Some areas have issues with the "camera follow" script. This is mostly solved but more testing and adjustments are required. In most areas the camera movement is working well.
[*] Side-quests and additional areas
[*]  Follower quests
[*] Better power/magic management (player choices)
[*] Improvements to details in certain areas
[*] More intractable NPC's
[*] Better light settings in some areas
[*] Save/load multiple characters and area progress in all areas (most areas now has progress saving but not all)
[*] Improvements to character stats and character level (currently only automatically)
[*] Bug fixes, i.e. item cool-down in some areas/instances. 
[/list]

[h3]When will the game leave Early Access?[/h3]

Soon! April or Mai...
